runtime_prompt_en:
Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original woman in her mid-twenties wearing a deep-cobalt bikini. The casting is an original adult fashion model. She stands barefoot at a bright ocean waterline with her back toward the camera, her body remaining a clear rear view as she looks toward the horizon. Use a balanced vertical full-figure frame from a low camera position behind her at knee height. Her legs stay softly adducted with the knees close. The actual upper inner-thigh contours form clean opposing boundaries. Between those contours, a small background opening shows the pale beach, producing a visible thigh gap with believable anatomy. The appealing focal geometry remains a subtle part of the overall silhouette, and the opening is anatomical negative space, not shadow. Keep the geometry readable at thumbnail scale. Warm late-afternoon sunlight outlines her long dark wavy hair, shoulders, and calves; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon complete the serene coastal setting. Preserve natural proportions, authentic skin texture, confident posture, and polished commercial realism.

Avoid: over-processed retouching, unrealistic hands, excessive HDR, impossible perspective, broken facial features, plastic-looking skin, body distortion, distorted fingers, fake-looking background
